titulo: Say good morning before you open the laptop
caption:
Say good morning before you open the laptop

8:05. The laptop is still shut. Cella says good morning to the one next to her first, and only then opens it.

For whoever looks up first.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with a voice on a flat color background in a kitchen. At the top, the words: 8:05. For whoever says good morning before opening the laptop. A small doorway-shaped figure with white eyes stands to the left and a second small figure of another color stands to the right, with a small table between them holding a closed laptop and a white pill that says 8:05. The words appear one line at a time: 8:05. Laptop still shut. Good morning (a speech bubble from the first figure, the second turns to look and answers with a bubble that says morning). Now I open it (the laptop lid swings up and a star appears, both figures smile). The closing line: for whoever looks up first. Then: Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: Cella said good morning first today. Somebody said it right back.
evolucion: Tres apuestas (junta-ene-s2, seccion 3). (a) El cierre con persona, sin pedido: ninguna pieza pide guardar, comentar, compartir, enviar ni seguir (regla 8); el fijado es una frase de Cella que nombra al destinatario. Base de lectura: N2 16 % (14 de 88 Reels), 1,5 envios por 1.000 de alcance, mediana de alcance 117; con el mismo corte de la hora 168. (b) El destinatario como gancho: brazo A (abre con "For whoever ..." en el cuadro 0 y vuelve a cerrar) contra brazo B (solo cierra). Se mide a 48 h con medir.py (envios por 1.000 de alcance, vistas comprometidas) y a 7 dias con objetivos.py (N2, N4). Con 17 seguidores no separa causa de ruido: lectura de orden de magnitud. Hora (apuesta 3a): los Shorts de las 23:00Z contra los de 17:00Z de la misma semana.
